gen-gf-goldman-gf-alumni-sans: Goldman spreads wide with generous clearance, its round forms bending like open parentheses, while Alumni Sans sits below. Its gently shifting strokes make long stretches of sans text glide.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Commanding Goldman stretches its round letters wide, big in the lowercase and generous in clearance. Alumni Sans Pinstripe is the one for tight text, with no hairlines to squint at.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC runs squeezed and sans-serif, with oversized lowercase and stems just outweighing hairlines. And Goldman, wide and generous, is the real hook, its round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anaheim: Modern in feel, Anaheim gathers rounded glyphs into a dense huddle the eye slides through. Goldman, meanwhile, does the commanding with wide letters and a big lowercase height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-arsenal: Wide and loud: Goldman spaces its letters generously, with round forms like open parentheses. Arsenal does the quieter work, its x-height near the cap height and its strokes shifting only modestly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-arsenal-sc: Goldman stretches wide and bold, its round forms like open parentheses and its lowercase tall against the capitals. Arsenal SC tightens up behind it, with a faint thick-thin shift.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-basic: Gently stepped from small letters up to capitals and thoroughly tidy, the body sits under the wide, commanding Goldman heading. Basic stays clean and businesslike, so paragraph after paragraph goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-cal-sans: Round forms like open parentheses give Goldman its look, set wide with generous clearance. Cal Sans keeps one stroke width throughout, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, so longer text stays friendly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-courier-prime: Wide letters, round curves, a big lowercase: that's Goldman. Courier Prime, a monospace, fills most of the height with a drafting-pen line and generous round mouths, so longer text feels precise and structured.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fragment-mono: Wide, round, parenthesis-curved: Goldman makes the statement with generous clearance. Fragment Mono handles the detail, laying monospace letters out like nails on a ruler with strokes that never swell to slow the eye.
